verses.text: wajjahtu wajhii liman takriimuhu baanaa
fii shahri mawlidi man fil bahri rabbaanaa
lil laahi shukriya fii shahrir rabiihi hunaa
halab tidaa-il lazii likh taraa qurbaanaa
qad aqbalal khayru mimman laa shariika lahu
fil mulki wal hamdi israaran wa ihlaanaa
dahawtu barran rahiiman nihma karramanaa
fil barri wal bahri nihmal laahu mawlaanaa
kawwin bikun liya fii zal yawmi tawsihatan
hattaa uqiima lidiinil laahi arkaanaa
rabbaytanii faltahab lil haama yaa samadii
id maana khayrin wa is-haadan wa iskaanaa
rabbaytanii bahda it-haamin wa tarwiyatin
han yawmi tarwiyatin iz juhtu sad-yaanaa
makkantanii bahda dayqin suqta lii hulalan
muwassihan bahda maa qad hiqtu hur-yaanaa
naajaytukal yawma yaa man amsi karramanii
wa suqta lil yawma iiqaanan wa burhaanaa
isrif quluuban nasaaraa yaa qadiiru ilaa
nasrii wa rud liya man qad hazza aw haanaa
bikawnikal waahidal qahhaara munfaridan
liqhar hidaanaa halaa bushraaaya idmaanaa
nabbahtanii amsi tanbiihan araa hajaban
antal badiihul lazii maa zaala rahmaanaa
yassarta lii amsi hab lil yawma tawsihatan
bihaa ulaazimu maatardaahu ihsaanaa
aawaytanii bahda maa daaqal fu-aadu azan
fasarmadan liya rud jinnan wa insaanaa
aslamtu wajhii ilaykal yawma zaa khidamin
liman ghadawtu lahu kahban wa hassaanaa
dahaa midaadii qadaa haajii likhidmati man
tabshiruhu dararal ahdaa-i ansaanaa
muhammadin khayri khalqil laahi sayyidinaa
sallaa halyhil lazii adhuuhu tib-yaanaa
wajjih salaatan bitasliimin lahu abadan
wa lii bayaanan wa hannii kuffa his-yaanaa
hamaltanii rabbi bit takriimi duuna hanan
fil barri wal bahri zid rizqan wa tuklaanaa
mallikniyal haama yaa wahhaabu fawqa rajaa
ii waltarud liya hadaa-an wa muslaanaa
lii jud birizqin halaalin tayyibin wa qinii
maa lasta tardaahu israaran wa ihlaanaa
naajaytu barran rahiiman mughniyan wa lahu
amrii ufawwidu arjuu nasrahu laanaa
ushkur shukuuriya wassih lii hunaa wa ghadan
yaa waasihan mughniyan maazaala dayyaanaa
hab lii bikawnika wahhaaban munaaya mahan
hattaa akuuna bimaa-il ghaybi rayyaanaa
makkin wa wassih wa mukshijhal bitawsihatin
kalaylatil qadri ah-yaanan fa-ahyaanaa
fiikaj halil muksa zaa fan-yi bilaa zalalin
wa kammilan biya ah-yaanan fa-ahyaanaa
yassir liyal khayra wahsimnii wa zid rashadii
yaa naafihan lam yazal barran wa mannaanaa
ilayka qalbii wa jusmanii kazaaka yadii
yaa haadiyan lam yazal rabban wa hannaanaa
lii jud biluq-yaa zawil iimaani fii hajalin
hattaa tubashshira man qad kaana haznaanaa
bikawnikal qaahiral jabbaara rumtu hunaa
an laa unaaziha jabbaaran wa sultaanaa
